channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Now Even Nicotine Gum Has A Black Market
item.description: Australia's illicit nicotine market has expanded to include nicotine replacement products, with authorities seizing more than 650,000 pieces of unapproved nicotine gum in Brisbane. (Published on November 02, 2026bysubstack.com)

item.title: Bleed Us Dry | Vape Veteran on Big Tobacco’s Campaign to Crush Vaping | RegWatch
item.description: Regulatory uncertainty is placing increasing pressure on independent vaping businesses across the United States. Restrictions affecting shipping, payment processing and online sales are creating significant operational challenges for companies serving adult smokers. (Published on November 02, 2026byregulatorwatch.com)

item.title: Cobra Effect and the End of Age of Cigarettes
item.description: US cigarette sales are declining two to three times faster than their historical trend, raising questions about the future of tobacco control as smoking becomes less common. (Published on November 02, 2026bymedium.com)

item.title: Mice studies to simulate children exposure to “third hand” vaping are toxicological fiction
item.description: Eight mouse studies examining children's potential exposure to residual vaping aerosol have raised questions about the reliability of experimental models used in nicotine research. (Published on November 02, 2026bysubstack.com)
